Nexus-EDA Copilot

Overview

Nexus-EDA Copilot is a KiCad plugin that integrates AI agents to automate routine PCB design tasks: netlist analysis, BOM optimization, routing suggestions, and DRC assistance. It runs entirely on-device using quantized open-source LLMs (DeepSeek-V3, Llama-3.1-8B) with no cloud dependency.

Features

Netlist Analysis

Identify unrouted connections, floating nets, and placement issues using AI-powered analysis.

BOM Optimization

Cross-reference your BOM against LCSC / JLCPCB pricing catalogs to find cost savings.

Routing Agent

Get AI routing suggestions for selected nets with trace path optimization.

DRC Assistant

Natural-language summaries of DRC violations from pcbnew.
